title: Rediscovered "silver medalists" carry no WHY-NOW — only a score + a stale prior-outcome label
expected: Each rediscovered candidate shows an explicit why-now: what changed, or why this role fits them when the last one didn't — derived from the real fit delta against THIS job.
got: The Rediscovered wire row is {candidateId, label, archetype, score, prior} only (app/_lib/rediscover.ts:27-33). `prior` is a backward-looking label ('Rejected · <old role>', rediscover.ts:41-54), never a forward why-this-role reason. The panel renders score badge + name + prior chip (RediscoverPanel.tsx:67-73); the standing feed renders '<label> splňuje laťku pro <role>' (messages/cs.json:1909) — a score restatement, not a why-now. RediscoverPanel doesn't even show matched/missing skills the way RecruiterCandidates does.
l2_priority: Confirm no why-now copy appears live on a rediscovered row; check whether the 'prior' label is the only context a recruiter gets before reaching out.
suggested_acceptance: Each rediscovered candidate row carries a one-line why-now tied to THIS role (e.g. the gap that closed, the requirement they now meet, or why this role fits where the last didn't), not just a score and a backward 'Rejected · X' chip.

title: "Reach out" drafts AND sends the message under the bank's name in one click — Jana never reads the copy before it goes
expected: Jana sees the drafted outreach and approves/edits it before it is delivered under ČS's name — her hard requirement is 'would I actually send this from my account?'
got: useReachOut POSTs to /candidates/outreach (useReachOut.ts:29); the route files the entry then immediately runAutomationTask('outreach') which calls dispatchOutreach — a real send — in the same call (automation-run.ts:286, comms-dispatch.ts:160-180). There is no draft-review state: grep shows no 'outreach_drafted' event anywhere, and automation-run.ts:43-45 documents that outreach records 'outreach_sent', never a draft. The only feedback is an aria-live 'a first-touch message is on its way' (useReachOut.ts:43).
l2_priority: Fire one Reach-out live and confirm the message is dispatched with no opportunity to read/edit the body first; read the Outbox row to see what actually went out under the bank name.
suggested_acceptance: Reach-out shows the drafted subject+body for review (edit + confirm, or at least preview) before dispatch; or the dispatched copy is immediately visible/recallable so Jana can verify what was sent under ČS's name.

title: Outreach prompt gets thin context (title+company+skill list) and no ČS brand — signs off as generic 'Náborový tým'
expected: Send-ready copy under ČS's name: on-brand bank voice, role-specific, names why THIS person for THIS role.
got: draft_outreach's prompt receives only candidate.label, job.title, job.company, and a strengths list (automation.py:321-326) — no JD requirements, no ČS brand/tone, no signature identity. Both the LLM prompt and the deterministic body sign off 'Náborový tým' / 'The hiring team' (automation.py:333,339), not the bank. The deterministic Czech body itself is clean and human (automation.py:330-335) — a relative strength — but it is a generic recruiter template, not ČS-branded, and offers no role-specific hook beyond the title.
l2_priority: Read a live outreach draft and judge whether a senior sourcer would send it from her own account unchanged; check if it names ČS / sounds on-brand or reads as generic.
suggested_acceptance: The outreach prompt is grounded in the ČS brand/sender identity and the role's real requirements (not just a title), and the generated copy is signed/voiced as ČS — send-ready without a rewrite.

title: Outreach language is keyed off the candidate's profile language, not pinned to Jana's ČS locale
expected: For a Czech bank's sourcing, outreach renders in clean Czech for Czech candidates deterministically.
got: automation_cli passes no --lang to outreach (automation_cli.py:132) unlike prep (line 136); draft_outreach derives language via _candidate_lang(candidate) (automation.py:319). So a candidate whose stored profile language isn't Czech would get English outreach even from a ČS recruiter. The deterministic path does have a correct Czech branch (automation.py:329), so this only bites when candidate language is mis/under-detected.
l2_priority: Confirm outreach to a ČS-seeded candidate renders Czech; check a candidate with thin/absent language metadata doesn't fall back to English (_candidate_lang defaults to English unless 'czech'/'česk' is in the profile languages — automation.py:112).
suggested_acceptance: Outreach copy language is deterministically Czech for the ČS workspace (or recruiter-selectable, as the Campaign tab already is), not silently dependent on candidate-profile language detection.

title: The role→candidates scan Jana uses gives deterministic scores+skills but NO per-candidate LLM verdict/strengths/gaps/probes
expected: From a role, each ranked candidate carries a reason she'd repeat to a hiring manager — verdict + strengths + gaps + interview probes tied to this CV and this JD.
got: The 'Explain fit' reasoning affordance (verdict/strengths/gaps/probes via runReasoning) lives ONLY on the Match tab's MatchCard (MatchCard.tsx:128-137; grep confirms 'reasoning' appears only under app/features/sub_match). Jana's actual job→candidates surface, RecruiterCandidates in the Job modal (JobPostingModal.tsx:346), renders deterministic engine output only: score, confidence band, matched/missing skills with provenance, KO reasons (RecruiterCandidates.tsx:441-548). Strong, auditable, non-black-box — but the narrative 'reason I'd repeat to a manager' isn't reachable per-candidate from the Jobs side. Note the Match tab matches one candidate→many jobs, the reverse of her need.
l2_priority: From a real ČS role's candidate scan, confirm whether any per-candidate verdict/strengths/gaps narrative is reachable, or only the deterministic score+skills; judge if the skill-provenance breakdown alone clears her 'reason I'd repeat to a manager' bar.
suggested_acceptance: From the role→candidates scan, each (or the top-N) candidate exposes a reasoned verdict + strengths + gaps + interview probes grounded in this CV and this JD, not only a similarity score and skill chips.

title: STRENGTH — Match-tab reasoning honestly labels AI vs rule-based and binds the verdict to real candidate+job inputs
expected: No unexplained 'AI found these'; the basis is interrogable and the degrade-to-template path is disclosed.
got: ResolvedReasoning shows a source chip 'sourceLlm' vs 'sourceRuleBased' (+ cached suffix) on every verdict (MatchShared.tsx:73-76). The degrade seam is real and honest: past the ai_candidates allowance / missing key it pushes --no-llm and leaves the deterministic result uncached so it upgrades when allowance returns (reasoning-run.ts:63,98). The verdict is content-addressed on BOTH the candidate (input.keyPart) and the job payload (reasoning-run.ts:73-80), so it's bound to real inputs — not a black box. This is exactly the anti-black-box posture Jana wants; protect it and extend it to the Jobs-side scan.
l2_priority: Confirm the rule-based label actually shows on a keyless/over-quota run and the LLM label on a paid run.
suggested_acceptance: AI-vs-template provenance stays visible on every reasoned verdict and is carried into any new reasoning surface (e.g. a Jobs-side scan).

title: STRENGTH — outreach to rejected candidates is consent/anonymization-gated before send (won't embarrass the bank legally)
expected: Re-contacting a previously-rejected silver medalist must never go to someone whose processing consent expired or who was anonymized.
got: dispatchOutreach consults outreachSuppressionReason BEFORE sending and, on suppression, records 'outreach_suppressed' and returns the reason without a send (comms-dispatch.ts:164-173); automation-run.ts maps that to 'suppressed_anonymized'/'suppressed_consent_expired' so the UI can show 'cannot contact' rather than a false 'reached out' (automation-run.ts:290-294). A genuine GDPR/CAN-SPAM safety on exactly the rediscovery path that re-touches rejected people.
l2_priority: Confirm a consent-expired rediscovered candidate surfaces 'cannot contact' and no message leaves the Outbox.
suggested_acceptance: Outreach to a consent-expired/anonymized candidate is suppressed with a visible reason and no send; the audit log records the refusal.

title: STRENGTH — unscorable past candidates are surfaced as 'skipped', not silently dropped
expected: Rediscovery's promise is 'we won't let a strong past candidate fall through the cracks' — so a profile the ranker can't score must be visible, not vanish.
got: rediscoverForJob threads `skipped` (unscorable profiles) through the route (rediscover.ts:97-102, route.ts:25) and RediscoverPanel renders a SkippedCandidatesNote above the results even when the list is empty (RediscoverPanel.tsx:36-46,54). Good honesty about the limits of the automation.
l2_priority: Confirm a malformed seeded profile shows up in the skipped note rather than disappearing.
suggested_acceptance: Candidates the ranker cannot score are listed (with a reason) so a strong person is never silently dropped from rediscovery.

title: STRENGTH — a recruiter-ingested role (not just the seed corpus) ranks, because the live DB job is handed to the ranker
expected: A job Jana/Petra ingested or published ranks candidates too, not only the static seed roles.
got: The candidates route passes the live DB job directly to rankPoolForJob (candidates/route.ts:30-35) and reasoning-run hands the live corpus via --jobs-json with DB-wins-on-id (reasoning-run.ts:49-57). So an ingested role resolves against its real record end to end.
l2_priority: Ingest/publish a role and confirm its candidate scan + reasoning both run (not 'job not found').
suggested_acceptance: An ingested/published role ranks the pool and produces reasoning identically to a seed role.

title: Rediscovery / candidate scan depend on a populated pool with prior-outcome history — empty fixture = empty state, not a pass
expected: Rediscovery surfaces real silver medalists — which requires seeded candidates carrying rejected/role_closed/declined history.
got: buildCandidatePool() empty → candidates route returns 'No saved candidates yet' (candidates/route.ts:21-23) and rediscoverForJob returns empty (rediscover.ts:64). pickPrior only yields a silver medalist when a candidate has rejected/role_closed/declined/elsewhere history (rediscover.ts:41-54); the standing feed also needs a publish+sweep to have fired. Structural pass is conditional on the env.md fixture (ČS corpus + seeded pipeline with rejected candidates) actually existing — reachability deferred to L2.
l2_priority: Seed the ČS pipeline with rejected/role_closed candidates and confirm rediscovery actually surfaces non-empty silver medalists; without the fixture this is unreachable, not failing.
suggested_acceptance: With the standard ČS seed, opening a published role shows at least one rediscovered silver medalist with the expected prior-outcome chip.
